title: Anomaly Detection
motto: Normal is easy to define. Abnormal is whatever doesn't fit.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Normal is easy to define. Abnormal is whatever doesn't fit.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A credit card is used in New York at 2pm, then in Tokyo at 2:05pm. A factory sensor reads 150 degrees when the normal range is 80-120. A server sends 50,000 requests per second when the daily average is 200.
These are anomalies. Finding them matters. Fraud costs billions. Equipment failures cost downtime. Network intrusions cost data.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Z-score flags points far from the mean. Simple baseline before isolation forests and autoencoders.
